question: Actions of cholecystokinin include which one of the following?

options.opb: Secretion of pancreatic juice rich in enzymes

CHAIN: "Cholecystokinin release" -> "stimulates gallbladder and pancreas" -> "contraction of gall bladder and secretion of pancreatic juice rich in enzymes" -> "increases secretion of enterokinase" -> "All" -> 85%
analysis: Cholecystokinin is confirmed to cause contraction of the gallbladder and stimulate the secretion of enzyme-rich pancreatic juice, aligning with options opa and opb. The role in increasing enterokinase secretion (opc) is less certain. However, considering the need to select the most comprehensive answer, and given that opc is not entirely unsupported, 'All of the above' (opd) is chosen with a note of moderate confidence due to the slight uncertainty about the enterokinase aspect.
